title: E-komercijas bizness ar Claude: pilnais izstrādes žurnāls
seoTitle: E-komercijas bizness ar Claude | Mārketinga Skola
description: Kā viens cilvēks ar Claude palīdzību uzsāka e-komercijas biznesu: visas 25 izmaiņas, kāpēc tikai četras bija par AI un kā vest savu žurnālu.
facts: The source is Rihards Zeila's own English guide (rihardszeila.com/blog/ecommerce-business-built-with-claude), written from systems he runs himself. Take its content, numbers and steps; write the Latvian fresh, not sentence by sentence.
Never name the print-on-demand store, and never say or hint at what it sells, its theme or its niche: it is only 'a print-on-demand ecommerce project'.
